# Leila R. Golchehreh, Attorney at Law

> Mediation of commercial, corporate and workplace disputes, and fractional general counsel for technology companies from pre-seed through Series C. Admitted in California and New York. Works in English and French.

## Services

- Mediation: cofounder, shareholder, board, investor, commercial contract, executive and workplace, intellectual property and data disputes. Sessions in person or by video anywhere in the world. Mediation by the session.
- Fractional general counsel: commercial contracts, corporate governance, founder protections and equity, IP and open-source licensing, financings and M&A, privacy, security and AI regulatory matters, export controls. By monthly retainer.

## Who she is

- Attorney admitted in California and New York. LL.M. with distinction, French and European law, Sorbonne.
- Co-Founder, Chief Strategy Officer and Acting General Counsel of a venture and debt backed enterprise AI company, built from zero through a Series B.
- Counsel through the Adaptive Insights IPO and its acquisition by Workday. General Motors Cruise's first cybersecurity, AI and privacy lawyer. Earlier at A&O Shearman (Paris), the OECD and the U.S. Mission to the European Union.

## What this practice is not

- Not Silicon Valley Trust. Silicon Valley Trust is a domain name used by Lexplique LLC, an advisory and coaching practice which does not provide legal services. See https://siliconvalleytrust.com/
- Contacting this practice does not create an attorney-client relationship. One is formed only by a signed engagement letter after a conflicts check.
